issue.title: Share the import-graph cache host-locally across ephemeral workspaces
issue.description: Every fresh ephemeral sase_<N> workspace pays a cold ~8.4s AST build for static import-graph selection because .pytest_cache/sase-selection/graph.json is per-workspace. A ${SASE_HOME}/test-selection/graph cache keyed by (path, size, mtime_ns) would make the first scoped check in a new workspace as cheap as the second first-run cost. Proposed by epic sase-fp's land phase (sase-fp.8.3), originally measured during sase-fp.1 (Static import-graph selection engine).
